Residents:
Ines (70s, retired): Weekdays home most of the day; morning walk, afternoon errands. Weekends home most of the day; late-morning walk. Hobbies: friends, music, houseplants. Note: Was home sick on Friday, remaining indoors all day.
Yuki (70s, retired): Weekdays home most of the day; morning walk, afternoon errands. Weekends home most of the day; late-morning walk. Hobbies: meditation, movies, houseplants. Cares for the dog.
Hana (40s, WFH): Weekdays at desk 9:00–17:30, sometimes out for lunch. Weekends sleeps in, midday errands, home otherwise. Hobbies: movies, snacking.

Object Locations & Routines:
Most items remain in their Tuesday 18:00 walkthrough locations unless noted.

Kitchen (Active Zone):
- cutting_board_shared: Usually counter_k1. Moves to sink_k1 or kitchen_table_k1 during meal prep/cleanup.
- glass_hana, glass_yuki: Usually cupboard_k1. Move to kitchen_table_k1 or sink_k1 during evening use.
- kitchen_knife_shared, spatula_shared: Usually drawer_k_k1. Move to counter_k1 during cooking, back to drawer after.
- pan_shared, pot_shared: Usually cupboard_k1. Move to counter_k1 during cooking, back to cupboard/dish_rack after.
- serving_dish_shared: Usually cupboard_k1. Moves to sink_k1 or kitchen_table_k1 during meals.
- plate_hana, plate_yuki: Usually cupboard_k1. Move to kitchen_table_k1 for dinner, then sink_k1/dish_rack_k1.
- water_bottle_yuki: Usually dish_rack_k1. Moves to kitchen_table_k1 or sink_k1 during evening.
- water_bottle_ines: Usually kitchen_table_k1. Moves to sink_k1, coffee_table_l1, or counter_k1 depending on activity.
- water_bottle_hana: Usually desk_o1. Moves to kitchen_table_k1 or counter_k1 during breaks.
- mug_hana: Usually desk_o1. Moves to kitchen_table_k1 or sink_k1 during breaks.
- mug_ines: Usually kitchen_table_k1. Moves to coffee_table_l1 or dish_rack_k1.
- mug_yuki: Usually cupboard_k1. Moves to dish_rack_k1 or sink_k1.
- bowl_hana, bowl_ines, bowl_yuki: Usually cupboard_k1. Move to kitchen_table_k1 for breakfast, then sink_k1/dish_rack_k1.
- snack_bowl_shared: Usually cupboard_k1. Moves to sink_k1 or kitchen_table_k1 during snacking.
- shopping_bag_shared: Usually counter_k1. Moves to pantry_shelf_k1 after unpacking.

Entry & Personal Items:
- jacket_yuki: Usually entry_hook_e1.
- keys_hana: Usually entry_table_e1. May drop to entry_floor_e1.
- keys_yuki: Usually entry_table_e1.
- shoes_yuki: Usually shoe_rack_e1. May move to entry_floor_e1.
- phone_ines: Usually bed_b1. Moves to coffee_table_l1 or ON_PERSON during day.
- phone_yuki: Usually nightstand_b1. Moves to coffee_table_l1 or ON_PERSON during day.
- phone_hana: Usually nightstand_b2. Moves to ON_PERSON during work hours.

Bedroom 1 (Yuki/Ines Shared):
- scarf_yuki: Usually wardrobe_b1.
- sunglasses_yuki: Usually dresser_b1.
- wallet_yuki: Usually nightstand_b1. May move to entry_floor_e1.
- glasses_yuki: Usually nightstand_b1. Moves to desk_b1, bathroom_shelf_ba1, or armchair_l1.
- book_ines: Usually nightstand_b1. Moves to tv_stand_l1, coffee_table_l1, or side_table_l1.
- book_yuki: Usually nightstand_b1. Moves to armchair_l1.
- headphones
